name: Surface-Enhanced Tractography (SET)
summary: Generates a whole-brain tractogram with Surface-Enhanced Tractography (SET), seeding probabilistic tracking from FreeSurfer white matter surfaces, after registering the T1w to DWI with ANTs and computing FODFs with scilpy.
description: Registers the T1w to DWI space with ANTs (SyN, or affine only with linear_transformation), computes an order-8 FODF with scilpy unless one is supplied, and runs the SET engine (freesurfer_a2009s_proper profile only) for several random-seed chains, then concatenates them into one tractogram. Use it for surface-informed whole-brain tractography with better cortical terminations. Needs preprocessed DWI, FA, an ACPC-aligned T1w, a FreeSurfer directory and a 5TT mask (vol2 used as WM include, vol3 as CSF exclude).

inputs.description: Preprocessed DWI with bvecs and bvals.
FreeSurfer subject directory whose white matter surfaces seed tracking.
Tensor dataset; only the FA map is used.
ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image registered to DWI space.

inputs.requirements: Brainlife 5tt ordering: volume 2 is white matter (include), volume 3 is CSF (exclude).

inputs.description: Optional precomputed FODF (SH order 8, descoteaux07 basis); skips FODF computation.
Optional precomputed T1-to-DWI ANTs transform; skips registration.
inputs.requirements: Warp, inverse warp and affine must all be given together.

outputs.description: Final concatenated whole-brain tractogram from Surface-Enhanced Tractography (all 8 random-seed chains concatenated).
FODF (SH order 8, descoteaux07 basis) -- only produced when the fodf input wasn't already given.
T1-to-DWI ANTs registration transform -- only produced when the t1_transform input wasn't already given.

parameters.description: Comma-separated random seeds for SET tracking chains.
Dynamic seeding iterations per random seed.
Register T1 to DWI with an affine transform only (no SyN) and pass --transf-linear to SET.
Enable ANTs registration verbose output (produces very large logs; useful for debugging only).

citations.text: St-Onge E, Daducci A, Girard G, Descoteaux M. Surface-enhanced tractography (SET). NeuroImage 169:524-539 (2018).
